<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Elemental Thicket](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2679)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

In the [Universe](/Planes.aspx?ID=1), plant growth proceeds on a scale of days, weeks, years, and decades. Conversely, an elemental thicket grows constantly and in seconds. These writhing masses of living wood are the elemental embodiment of growth itself, swelling up when least expected to consume all in their path.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 28

**[Recall Knowledge - Plant](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 28

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 11">[Elemental Thicket](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2679)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 210

**Perception** +24

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +23

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +4

**Con** +6

**Int** +1

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 28 

**Fort** +20 

**Ref** +13 

**Will** +25 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 240

, regeneration 15 (deactivated by [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Weaknesses**
[axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1) 10, fire 15

**Entangling Growth** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) 30 feet. Plant life erupts out of any and all soil surrounding the elemental thicket, making the area [greater difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) out to 5 feet and difficult terrain out to 30 feet. This ability requires soil and has no effect on terrain without it, such as worked stone, solid rock, open water, etc.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, burrow 25 feet, climb 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
gnarled branch +24 ([reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d12+7 bludgeoning plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=10)** <actions string="Single Action" />  1d12+7 bludgeoning, DC 30.

**[Engulf](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=14)** <actions string="Two Actions" />  DC 30, 8d10 bludgeoning, [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) DC 27, Rupture 20.

</column>
